text: Today we're talking about how lifestyles in Viet Nam have changed over the years. Can you tell us about your experience?
Well, when I was young, most women stayed at home to take care of the family. Now, more women are working outside the home.
We used to ride bicycles everywhere. Now, motorbikes and cars are very common. It's much faster, but there's more traffic.
In the past, we wrote letters. Now, everyone uses smartphones and social media to stay in touch.
